parrafo.es: Boca Skin Spa es el spa boutique de la esteticista Carla Columbia en Boca Raton, FL. Facials personalizados, tratamiento de acné, microneedling y diseño de cejas, en un espacio pensado para relajarte de verdad. Se reserva en línea o llamando directamente al spa.
parrafo.en: Boca Skin Spa is esthetician Carla Columbia's boutique spa in Boca Raton, FL. Personalized facials, acne treatment, microneedling and brow design, in a space built for real relaxation. Book online or call the spa directly.

hero.imagen_alt: Treatment room at Boca Skin Spa in Boca Raton, FL, ready for a facial appointment

parrafo_1.es: Boca Skin Spa es el spa de rejuvenecimiento y bienestar de Carla Columbia, sobre NW 13th St, en Boca Raton. Con más de 20 años de experiencia, Carla atiende cada cita en persona: facials personalizados, tratamiento de acné, microneedling, dermaplaning, chemical peels y diseño de cejas, siempre con un diagnóstico honesto de lo que tu piel necesita.
parrafo_1.en: Boca Skin Spa is Carla Columbia's rejuvenation and wellness spa on NW 13th St in Boca Raton. With 20+ years of experience, Carla handles every appointment herself: personalized facials, acne treatment, microneedling, dermaplaning, chemical peels and brow design, always with an honest read of what your skin actually needs.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientas lo repiten en Google desde hace años: algunas llevan más de una década reservando solo con Carla. La describen como clínica y lujosa a la vez, con un servicio experto que nunca deja la piel marcada ni irritada. 5.0 de calificación en 39 reseñas en Google.
parrafo_2.en: Her clients say the same thing on Google, year after year: some have been booking with Carla for over a decade. They describe her work as the perfect balance of clinical and luxury, expert service that never leaves skin marked up or irritated. A 5.0 rating across 39 reviews on Google.

items.quote: I have been getting facials for 20 years in LA, Vegas and South Florida. CARLA by far is the best if you want a real facial that leaves you feeling clean and rejuvenated. She isn't just rubbing products in your face. She understands skin health and I never leave there all marked up... just with a fresh happy face.

Carla's been my esthetician for 15 years, and she is the best! She is professional, caring, and honest. She will advise on your skin care needs, and always expert service. Her facials, waxing, and her ability to design your brows in a way that always flatters is her amazing craft. I won't go to anyone else.....love her! You won't be disappointed. She IS THE BROW QUEEN! :)

I have been seeing Carla for 8+ years and she is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! There is nobody like her, true perfection and talent with everything she does and I will never stop using her. I couldn't recommend her more! Check her out, you won't be dissapointed ❤️
